scope: Broaden the ACIS control-author search beyond mesh-derived polyhedra, refresh ACadRust's exact release/readiness boundary, and assess one optional SAT/SAB reader route without changing runtime dependencies or support claims.

method.kind: Read-only review of primary project release, source, API documentation, issue, and vendor reader documentation, reconciled against the existing implementation plan.
method.evidenceBoundary: Release notes, current source/API documentation, open issue reports, and vendor product documentation establish candidate scope and caveats only. No generated body, parser, B-rep kernel, or native application was executed; this review does not qualify any new support profile.

observed: Release dated 2026-10-11 advertises generation-specific ACIS silhouette and inline-surface fixes and strict reads of its supplied sample corpus, plus Rust test/package verification.
The release manifest identifies the crate as MPL-2.0; no dependency or source code was added to libdxfrw.
Current crate API docs describe primitive constructors for box, wedge, pyramid, cylinder, cone, sphere, torus, and planar closed polyhedra, with topology/reference-closure checks.
The docs.rs latest API page still labels itself 0.5.5 while GitHub lists v0.6.4, so the exact builder API and output profile must be confirmed against the pinned 0.6.4 package/source before use.
evidence.planUse: At one composed external checkpoint only, use out-of-tree generated analytic controls if the toolchain and exact API pin are already available. Inspect emitted SAT/SAB headers/profile, use independently calculated expected metrics, and pass the bytes through separately qualified parser/kernel paths. Its own validation/readback is not B-rep or native acceptance evidence.

observed: Open issue reports 70/351 private AC1032 files failing under v0.6.4 after stricter record bounds, mostly on AcDbMLeaderObjectContextData and a few associative records.
The issue author says the same drawings open in v0.6.3, AutoCAD and ODA File Converter; the files were not published in the review.
The maintainer proposed a fix and requested a reporter retest; the issue remains open, so release/current-branch status is not resolved by the review.
evidence.planUse: Keep ACadRust whole-DWG comparison advisory and exact-release-bound. Separate modeler-payload testing from unrelated full OBJECTS-pass failures where possible; do not attribute the report to libdxfrw.

observed: Vendor docs describe a standalone SAT/SAB reader on Windows and Linux, import of solid/surface/line bodies, and listed versions R1 through 2023.
The docs explicitly say there is no CAD associativity or CAD parameter support; this route does not read DWG/DXF container-level AcDs links or modeling history.
evidence.planUse: Consider only at the existing composed checkpoint if already licensed and authorized; otherwise do not install, purchase, trial, or add it as a dependency. It does not replace open-source evidence or source-native AC1027+ owner/join qualification.

planDelta.existingGateRefined: Optional ACadRust analytic control generation at the composed checkpoint, covering selected curved families only if the exact release API and emitted profile are verified.
nextActions: Continue local implementation with focused generated tests; optional peer runtimes remain out of the leaf-slice loop.

Record generated input hash, exact SAT/SAB profile, libdxfrw carrier/owner chain, independent parser status, kernel geometry metrics, and named application result as separate evidence stages.
Keep J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
